specs.The click you expect. The sound you don': Experience the same satisfying click feel with up to 90% less noise on the left and right buttons.
specs.More ways to get things done: Six buttons, a 3D metal scroll wheel, and a DPI switch put everyday control at your fingertips.
specs.From desk to marble: The multi-surface red optical sensor tracks smoothly across a wide range of surfaces, even marble.
specs.Built for everyday use: The full-size ambidextrous design feels natural in either hand for all-day productivity.
specs.Wireless, made easy: Connect instantly with the USB-A nano receiver and enjoy a stable 2.4 GHz wireless connection.
specs.Controls: 6 Buttons, 3D Metal scroll wheel, DPI switch button
specs.Compatible Devices: Laptops, Desktops, Tablets with USB ports
